episodes.title: Peptides 101: What They Are & How They Work
episodes.description: Just getting started? Sarah, Keisha, and Minh break down exactly what peptides are, how they signal your cells, and why they're the hottest topic in health optimization.
showNotes: Peptides are short chains of amino acids — your body's natural signaling molecules
Unlike steroids, peptides tell your body what to do rather than doing it themselves
Key categories: GLP-1s, Repair peptides, Cognitive peptides, Longevity peptides
Always start with a single peptide to understand how your body responds
Third-party testing (COAs) is non-negotiable for safety

episodes.title: GLP-1 Deep Dive: Tirzepatide vs Semaglutide
episodes.description: The ultimate comparison. We break down the mechanisms, results, side effects, and costs of the two most popular GLP-1s — plus a look at the emerging triple agonist Retatrutide.
showNotes: Semaglutide (Ozempic/Wegovy): Single GLP-1 agonist, the gold standard
Tirzepatide (Mounjaro/Zepbound): Dual GLP-1/GIP agonist, often more effective
Retatrutide: Triple agonist (GLP-1/GIP/GCG) in Phase 3 trials
Side effects comparison: nausea, fatigue, sulfur burps, constipation
Cost: Brand $1,000+/mo, Compounded $300-500

episodes.title: 5 Peptide Myths That Won't Die
episodes.description: Are peptides steroids? Do you have to inject? Will you gain it all back? We tackle the most persistent myths in the peptide world with science and real experience.
showNotes: Myth 1: Peptides are steroids — FALSE, completely different mechanisms
Myth 2: You don't need to exercise on GLP-1s — DANGEROUS
Myth 3: Once you start, you're on them forever — FALSE
Myth 4: All peptides are the same — FALSE, purity varies wildly
Myth 5: More is better — FALSE, peptides follow a U-shaped curve

episodes.title: BPC-157: The Injury Repair Powerhouse
episodes.description: From tendon healing to gut repair — we explore why BPC-157 is the most talked-about repair peptide. Real protocols, real results, and what the research actually says.
showNotes: BPC-157 discovered in gastric juice, promotes angiogenesis
Common protocols: 250-500mcg twice daily, 4-6 week cycles
Best for: tendonitis, ligament injuries, gut healing
Always pair with TB-500 for synergistic repair effects
Oral BPC-157 arginate capsules show promise

episodes.title: Protein, Sleep & Peptides: The Optimization Triad
episodes.description: Peptides work best when your foundation is solid. We cover why protein is non-negotiable, how sleep optimization amplifies results, and the lifestyle habits that make or break your protocol.
showNotes: Protein target: 1g per pound of goal body weight
Sleep is when growth peptides (Ipamorelin, CJC-1295) do their work
Hydration: 3-4L water daily prevents peptide face
Strength training protects muscle mass during fat loss
Track everything: symptom tracker, protein intake, sleep quality

episodes.title: NAD+ & Longevity: Can We Slow Aging?
episodes.description: NAD+ is the hottest molecule in longevity science. We explore what it does, how peptide precursors work, and whether the hype matches the science.
showNotes: NAD+ levels decline ~50% from age 20 to 60
Precursors: NMN, NR, NAD+ itself — different absorption profiles
Benefits: energy, DNA repair, mitochondrial health
Protocols: Sublingual, injection, or IV
Stack with: MOTS-C, SS-31, Glutathione
